verdict.rationale: Perplexity documents two official MCP servers. The Perplexity MCP Server gives AI assistants its search and reasoning capabilities. The Computer MCP server lets any MCP client delegate multi-step tasks (web browsing, sandboxed code, 400+ connectors) and receive structured results. A probe independently confirmed the official MCP server documentation page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually connecting through these MCP servers.
